dataset_bundle.name: CY-Bench
dataset_bundle.release_attribution: user-declared; local archive checksum not compared
dataset_bundle.folder_convention: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code / crop; variable_croptype_country.csv

version_history.1.0: Dataset submitted to NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks; paper discussion: https://openreview.net/forum?id=jkJDNG468g#discussion
version_history.1.1-1.2: Corrected column-name issues and adm_id mismatches between yield output and predictor inputs.
version_history.1.3: Added location centroids and administrative polygons; the local CSV extract contains centroid fields, not polygon geometry.
version_history.1.7: Stored values at three-decimal precision to reduce size.
version_history.1.9: Added VPD and location; switched ET0 from AQUASTAT-FAO to AgERA5 2.0 (previously AgERA5 1.1).
version_history.1.10: Added region_area to location, added crop_mask, and fixed an Australia yield error.

management_scenario.description: Maize monoculture with no fertilizer applied
management_scenario.note: User-provided interpretation of mm0; confirm against dataset documentation.

crop_calendar.description: Start and end of growing season

fpar.description: Fraction of absorbed photosynthetically active radiation

fpar.definition: fraction of absorbed photosynthetically active radiation

meteorology.source: AgERA5 2.0 (Boogaard et al., 2022); ET0 is AgERA5 in v1.10 (previously AQUASTAT-FAO)

prec.note: The notation mm0 is treated as the management scenario code; the millimeter unit is inferred and needs source confirmation.

soil.description: Available water capacity, bulk density, and drainage class

awc.definition: available water capacity; centimeters of available water per meter of soil depth
awc.note: Unit clarified by user as cm m-1.

yield.description: End-of-season yield statistics; source varies by country/region
yield.source: Country- or region-specific sources; AgML-CY-Bench data_preparation references

location.description: Subnational unit centroid and region area

crop_mask.description: Crop area fraction by subnational unit
crop_mask.source: WorldCereal (Van Tricht et al., 2023; EC-JRC, 2024), included in CY-Bench v1.10

crop_area_percentage.definition: fraction of subnational-unit area covered by crop

notes: This project uses only the maize/Argentina partition at AR/maize; other crops and countries are out of scope.
The local v1.10 yield CSV includes planting_year, planting_date, harvest_date, and planted_area beyond the supplied v1.10 schema summary.
The location coordinate reference system was not provided, and polygon geometry is not present in the local CSV files.
